comment: Model catalogue. Every entry with "verified": false has NOT been checked against the live
repository — the file name, size and digest are conventional guesses, not facts. The CLI and
the UI say so, and ModelInstaller refuses to install an entry whose sha256 is null unless the
caller explicitly opts out of verification.
To pin an entry properly, see docs/MODELS.md: fetch the repository's file listing, copy the LFS
oid (which is the SHA-256) and the size into this file, and flip "verified" to true.
tdt-0.6b-v3-f16 carries a digest with "verified" still false, and that combination is
deliberate. The digest is of a copy that decoded three hours of speech correctly on three
consecutive runs, so it pins bytes known to work and every future download is checked against
it. What it is not is the digest the repository publishes, because that listing has not been
read. Flip "verified" only once the LFS oid confirms this value.

models.notes: Default choice. Quantisation quality on this engine is unmeasured: the analogous ONNX INT8 export collapsed to 24.8% long-audio WER against 7.8% for fp32, and it collapsed silently, producing fluent wrong text. Measure against f16 before trusting it.
The reference for accuracy. Every quantisation claim in this project must be measured against this file, on real disfluent audio, including files over ten minutes.
Smallest. Also the most likely to fail silently: assume nothing about its accuracy until it is measured against f16 on long, real audio.
